title: LookExpressions
description: A1732 (B2716 (2), Marcel W2073): how feelings and moments show on the body, over the running action - a face and an arm gesture, from an event of the inhabitant (an invention: cheering), a mood above a level (sadness: a sad face) or a need below one (tired: a yawn now and then). Presentation only, calm (B2466); a gesture shows only while the figure stands idle or walks, never over an action's own gesture and never lying.

cooldown_s.description: Real seconds after an event's expression before the next event shows one (calm).

events.description: Events of the inhabitant (vocabulary event) and the short expression they show.

moods.description: A mood at or above a level shows an expression while it lasts (first match wins).

needs.description: A need at or below a level shows an expression while it lasts (after the moods).

join_in.description: A1733 (B2716 (3)): others nearby and awake notice one of these expressions - they look over for a while and may show an expression of their own (joining in the joy). Presentation only; absent = nobody looks over.

radius_m.description: How near (metres, on the ground) another figure must be to notice it.

look_s.description: Real seconds the others look over (head and upper body).

expression.description: The expression they show themselves (subject to their own calm pause); missing = they only look.

face.description: Face of the figure while it shows; missing = neutral.

gesture.description: Id of a gesture of look figures 'gestures'; missing = none.

seconds.description: How long an event's expression shows (real seconds); moods and needs show while they last.

look_s.description: A1542: as the expression starts, the figure looks to the player (the camera) for these real seconds - standing it turns to it (a knock at the glass); missing = it does not.

detail.description: Only events with this detail (e.g. the message kind of mail_arrived: knock); missing = any.

skips_pause.description: A1542: shows even within the calm pause (a knock is a call to the player, not a mood); missing = false.
